name: exec_pop_lifecycle_without_cachepolicy

provenance.source: Exact .139 pagemanager decompilation; page lifecycle ladder recovered from the state byte at page+40 and the handler-chain callbacks.

notes: Runs pause, stop and destroy on a page REGARDLESS of its cache policy at page+41, ending in lv_obj_delete of the root view at page+48. The with-cachepolicy variant (0x0c696eb8) used by ordinary navigation stops early for policy 2/5/6/7 and leaves the widgets alive. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
